title: Approvals fail closed: default ask; routines gated like webhooks; shell/write_file/spawn_bot/schedule_create not exempt
description: Evidence: packages/core/src/action-approval.ts:168-170 default allow; :103 unattendedTriggerToolRequiresApproval only for trigger=webhook — a 03:00 routine gets unreviewed shell; :3-23 APPROVAL_EXEMPT_TOOLS wrongly includes shell/write_file/spawn_bot/schedule_create. Do: default decision ask when no rule matches (keep explicit allow rules working); treat trigger in {webhook, routine, cron, schedule} as unattended; remove the four tools from the exempt set; update tests (action-approval.test.ts) to the new defaults. AC: pnpm --filter @rakazo/core test green with new cases: (a) no rules + shell → ask, (b) routine trigger + shell → requires approval, (c) explicit allow rule still allows.

context.text: fix(core): fail-closed approvals + gate routine triggers — 96aca0c
